summary: Describes extensions to OSPF version 2 for intra-area traffic engineering, carried in Opaque Link State Advertisements. They let routers advertise extra link information that supports choosing paths based on more than simple shortest distance. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Maps usually show just distance. This adds notes like how wide each road is, so traffic planners can choose paths that avoid jams instead of always taking the shortest way.
